aiTask: Classification and extraction of structured data from geological PDF files
inputSpecification: PDF files, primarily geological reports. The input can be a single PDF file or a directory of PDF files. The classifier categorizes individual PDF pages into document classes.
outputSpecification: JSON output containing document structure metadata and page level document class predictions. Page types include: Text, Boreprofile, Maps, TitlePage, GeoProfile, Table, Diagram and Unknown.
trainingDataOrigin: Manually labelled geological documents from Switzerland
